title: Quality management, supplier audits and terms of sale | Aquemi
meta: How our quality management system controls changes, nonconformances, traceability, calibration and suppliers, how to audit it, and our terms of sale.
headline: Audit our quality system before you award
lead: Our quality management system, the record each process leaves, and our terms of sale.

blocks.h: Each process, and the record it leaves
blocks.intro: An auditor picks a joint, certificate or change and asks how.
rows: Change control
Impact assessed before work continues; your approval for documents you approved
Change request with impact assessment; change control register
Nonconformance and complaints
Items held and decided; repeat, systemic or client-reported causes get a corrective and preventive action (CAPA)
Nonconformance report (NCR); CAPA with effectiveness check; complaint log
Identification and traceability
Product-contact parts traced by lot or serial number to joint and drawing
Material log against [PP material certificates]; joint log and maps
Calibration
Traceable to national standards through [calibration provider and accreditation held]; an out-of-tolerance result reopens every reading since the last
Calibration register; as-found and as-left certificates
Document control
Only the current approved revision issued; superseded ones withdrawn and kept
Document register; client comment logs
Supplier control
Product-contact and special-process suppliers approved before use, reviewed on a schedule
Approved supplier list; incoming inspection records
Internal audit and management review
Each process audited by someone independent of it; results reviewed by management
Audit reports; management review minutes

blocks.h: How a defect is held and closed

items.d: Whoever finds it tags and segregates the item, or stops work, and raises an NCR.
Reject, rework or accept as is. Accepting as is, or an unapproved repair, needs your approval.
A rejected product-contact joint is cut out and remade to [PP joint repair rule], under a new number.
Repeat, systemic or client-reported: cause found, procedure, training or supplier changed.
Evidence after an agreed period that the action worked, signed before the CAPA closes.
Every NCR logged in your package; one after shipment reaches you within [NCR notice after shipment, working days].

blocks.h: Request an audit or questionnaire pack
blocks.intro: Audits from [quality system ready for audit, date]; we reply within [audit request response time, working days]; cost: [supplier audit before order, free or charged].

fields.label: Your questionnaire, audit checklist or quality agreement

items.a: [ISO 9001 status, registrar and expiry]. Either way, your audit can test the system itself: the processes above and a sample traced end to end.

items.q: Can we audit you before we order?
items.a: From [quality system ready for audit, date]: remotely, or on site at [shop location, city and province] with [on-site audit notice, working days] notice. Cost: [supplier audit before order, free or charged].

items.q: What is in the questionnaire pack?
items.a: Our questionnaire or yours, procedure list, certification status and organization chart. Specimen records: a nonconformance, its corrective and preventive action, and a change request. Corporate registration, certificates of insurance, workers' compensation clearance and safety program.

items.q: Will you sign our quality agreement?
items.a: We return a mark-up with the quote, within [quality agreement mark-up turnaround, working days]. Send it with your request for proposal.
[role that releases to ship, and its independence]. Nothing ships with an open nonconformance report (NCR) on a product-contact part unless you approved its disposition.
